name: lane-kit
description: N simultaneous sessions (lanes) on the same repo, without collisions: a state board (CLAIMED->BUILDING->CHECKPOINT-READY->UNDER-REVIEW->VERIFIED/NEEDS-FIX->MERGED) with cross-model maker!=checker enforced in code, a registry of live lanes with heartbeat/liveness, a git guard (blocks commit -a/add -A/reset --hard while another lane is live) and a territory guard (red zones + exclusive territory). Depends on continuity-kit (the handoff's lane_id field).
